portal_hypertension.title: Coexistence of hepatopulmonary syndrome and portopulmonary hypertension before a liver transplantation: a case report and review of the literature.
portal_hypertension.authors: Tazibt D, Vacelet V, Vendeville S
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：有效治疗肺动脉高压后，肝移植成为可能，肝移植后 3 年取得了良好的结果。 临床提示：最后，我们的病例报告和文献综述表明，晚期肝病患者中 HPS 和 PoPH 的共存可能...
portal_hypertension.abstract: Liver transplantation remains the treatment of choice for hepatopulmonary syndrome (HPS) with severe hypoxemia, but portopulmonary hypertension (PoPH) has traditionally been viewed as a contraindication to liver transplantation owing to its frequent posttransplant deterioration. We describe here the sequential presence of both pulmonary vascular disorders in a cirrhotic patient in the pretransplant period. Liver transplantation was made possible following effective management of pulmonary hypertension, with favorable outcome 3 years post-liver transplantation. Finally, our case report and literature review suggest that the coexistence of HPS and PoPH in patients with advanced liver disease c...

portal_hypertension.title: Massive bleeding from a Bricker ileal conduit during FOLFIRINOX therapy in noncirrhotic portal hypertension: suspected oxaliplatin-associated sinusoidal injury and presumed irinotecan-associated conduit mucositis: a case report.
portal_hypertension.authors: Drobot RB, Ślósarz T, Antoniewicz AA
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：根治性膀胱切除术后回肠导管出血并不常见，通常归因于肿瘤复发、感染、结石或局部造口创伤。 临床提示：FOLFIRINOX 进一步增加了诊断的复杂性，因为奥沙利铂可能导致肝窦内皮损伤和非肝硬化性门静脉高压，而伊立替康可能损害胃肠粘膜。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Bleeding from an ileal conduit after radical cystectomy is uncommon and is usually attributed to tumor recurrence, infection, stones, or local stomal trauma. Portal hypertensive stomal varices are rare. FOLFIRINOX adds further diagnostic complexity because oxaliplatin may cause sinusoidal endothelial injury and noncirrhotic portal hypertension, whereas irinotecan may damage gastrointestinal mucosa. We report a case of massive hemorrhage from a long-functioning Bricker ileal conduit during FOLFIRINOX therapy.
